Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nikhil - 9 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
4. Sharda - 65 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Naira - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Neeta and Nikhil stand near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Tanay (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay swings on the swing.]

Tanay (excited): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Neeta: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Tanay stands in the bedroom. Neeta and Sharda stand near him.]

Neeta: "Tanay, look over here."

[Tanay goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Tanay (softly): "Show me too!"

[Tanay sits on the edge of the bed.]

Sharda: "And then?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Neeta, Nikhil and Naira stand near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Neeta: "Tanay, look at this."

[The sun is blazing and Tanay is sweating.]

Tanay: "I really enjoyed today."
